description: Output of vsdd story deliver (pipeline.md#2.10.8, BLUEPRINT.md#4.10). The command prints every field on every exit, empty where it has nothing to say, so a script never reads an absent field.

ok.description: False only when the command did not reach an actionable state. The per-state ok list is defined once in the story-deliver command spec (rewrite/spec/commands/story-deliver.md).

error.description: One line a person can act on; empty when ok.

state.description: Empty only when the command itself could not run.

pr.description: The pull request link; empty in local mode.

detail.description: What failed, for the repair step.

reviewed_sha.description: The commit the converged verdict covers.

changed_files.description: The files changed from reviewed_sha to the delivered head; after a repair, the list the scoped review is accountable for.

diff_patch.description: The patch from reviewed_sha to the head, for the scoped review after a repair.
